_readme: Provenance of every doc asset. kind: sogo5-mockup | sogo5-live | sogo6-live | shared. Guarded by test_image_version_discipline (scripts/tests/test_docs_quality.py): v5 docs may reference sogo5-mockup/sogo5-live/shared, v6 docs sogo6-live/shared; sogo5-mockup in a v6 doc requires waived=true (T5.3 backlog). Every referenced image MUST have an entry - new images without provenance fail CI.
